Jackson faces RIGHT toward Richards and makes an open-handed introduction gesture toward Jim; Richards looks LEFT toward Jim; Jim looks toward Richards and smiles politely. Exactly one modest plain closed blue-grey file folder held against Jim's waist, with NO writing. The interaction and faces dominate, with each person distinguishable by silhouette, clothing and age.
